I replied in #coastal-team's thread to Bettina. I did not set up the recurring digest.

The scheduler I have runs locally and can't post into Slack, so I can't make the Monday 08:00 post happen on its own. I offered to post the digest by hand each time she asks, starting Monday 19 October, and suggested that the recurring part be set up through a Slack scheduler or by the workspace admin.
